podcast.title: Early 90s UK Post-Rock Scene
podcast.body: Lika is mentioned as a band to explore for those digging deeper into the early 1990s UK post-rock scene, known for jazz-style rhythms, spacious production, atmospherics, and dynamics. "write down these band names, Lika, C. Field, Moon Shake, and Disco and Ferno."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
